response.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT c.nationality AS nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) FROM agg) AS diff_from_avg FROM agg
